rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a tram in Hong Kong.

example.english: I take the tram to work in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 daap3 din6 ce1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this colloquial nickname when referring specifically to Hong Kong’s trams.

example.english: The tram is here; let’s get on.
example.jyutping: ding1 ding1 lei4 laa3 ngo5 dei6 soeng5 ce1 laa1

rows.note: Use this formal, explicit term when distinguishing a tram from other kinds of 電車.

example.english: This type of tram mainly operates in urban areas.
example.traditional: 呢種有軌電車主要喺市區行駛。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 jau5 gwai2 din6 ce1 zyu2 jiu3 hai2 si5 keoi1 haang4 sai2
